declaration.intent: Defines the foundational rules, conventions, and scope for the Forge Stack. This capsule is the root of the inheritance chain. v6 ratifies the policy of shipping a reference implementation for each stack stage.

ledger_scope.rule: The Forge Stack maintains a multi-scope ledger system: a single root ledger for stack-level history, and separate consumer ledgers for each downstream scope (including dedicated author scopes). This preserves truthful history while preventing root-scope drift.

root_ledger_scope.description: The root ledger tracks the integrity and evolution of the Forge Stack itself. It is the authoritative history for core components and governance.
includes: All capsules and referenced documents within the `sc/` directory.
HAL seals related to root governance and stack-wide policy.
State-change events from core stack components.
excludes: Any capsule, document, or event originating from the `consumer/` directory.
Author-tier style capsules (`giblets-forge/style/*`) when stored under consumer scope.

consumer_ledger_scope.description: Each consumer scope maintains its own independent ledger, tracking its own history, capsules, and domain-specific events.
consumer_ledger_scope.rule: A consumer ledger is governed by root stack governance but managed within its own scope. The `ledger.py` tool should be run with a scope appropriate to the target ledger.

author_scope.rule: All author-tier style capsules with `scp_id` prefix `giblets-forge/style/` are canonical in the dedicated `giblets-forge` consumer scope and are ledgered in `consumer/giblets-forge/ledger.jsonl`.

datacube_artefacts.rule: Defines ratified policies for DataCube artifacts, as proposed in docs/datacube-implementation-definition.md.

file_extension.description: The canonical file extension for DataCube projection artifacts.

manifest_membership.description: Cubes are considered pin-only artifacts. They are witnessed by pinning their hash to a ledger but are not included as members of a stack manifest. This parallels the handling of consumer-scope capsules.

implementation_policy.rule: Defines the project's stance on providing reference implementations versus protocol-only specifications.

reference_implementations.description: The Forge Stack project commits to shipping a reference implementation for each of its core spine stages (SCP, DataCube, Leighton Weight, ChronoSCRIBE, HAL). While the stack is protocol-first, providing a working, verifiable implementation is a required deliverable for each stage to ensure clarity, testability, and a baseline for interoperability.

constraints.immutability: Documents and capsules are never edited in place. A revision is a new capsule identity inheriting from its predecessor. All such changes are recorded in the appropriate ledger.

conventions.rule: Defines house style for language and identifiers.
conventions.separators: scp_id values MUST use hyphens (-) as separators, not underscores (_).
